Initially conceived as a homologation model for the German Touring Car Championship, it developed into being one of the world's hottest street sports car. Whenever its name is mentioned, car fans feel goosebumps - even today: the BMW M3.

programme.title: Ignition GT
programme.desc: Ernest drives SA’s most affordable new EV, the Geely E2. We travel to the US to learn more about Stellantis’s future plans and Juliet reconnects with Renault’s updated Captur.

programme.title: Buyer's Guide
programme.desc: The team helps a first-time buyer finance the right car, compares SUVs for a growing family, and explains when it's time to replace brake discs.

programme.title: Garage Gold
programme.desc: We’re in Johannesburg for the annual Angela’s Picnic. Mmasea meets up with the ultimate American muscle car aficionado. And we have two iconic BMWs going head to head in our Garage Gold Concourse Competition.

programme.title: Petrolheads
programme.desc: We explore an intriguing bakkie that drew a lot of attention at the Emperor’s Palace Motorshow, witness S’bu taking on the racetrack to discover Mzanzi’s fastest celebrity, and connect with an MG Car Crew.

programme.title: Riding with Ken Block in the Ford F-150 RaptorTRAX
programme.desc: He has chased some of the most savage cars over all continents, but for his latest adventure, Ken Block heads to the mountains to pilot a Ford Raptor with a 6.2-litre supercharger and snowTRAX.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: When Land Rover decided to end their production of the Defender after more than 60 years, a successor needed to be determined. Also: the SsangYong Rexton, the Jeep Renegade and our pick of the top 5 off-roaders.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.sub-title: Alpina B5 Touring vs. Jaguar XF Sportbrake
programme.desc: The Audi RS6 and the Mercedes E63 AMG are the two top sportsters among station wagons. Alpina came up with the B5 Twin Turbo, their BMW-based answer to the competition. Also: the agile Skoda Octavia Combi. And: the Jaguar XF Sportbrake.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: The off-road specialists from Delta 4x4 turned a Volkswagen Amarok into their so-called Beast and challenged Toyota off-road expert Alexander Wohlfarth in his Toyota Hilux. Which one of these 4x4 powerhouses fares better?

programme.title: Cadillac Escalade
programme.desc: The Cadillac Escalade at first seems like a typical rather beefy American car, but this luxurious SUV is more of a lovable, gentle giant, that should be able to gain sympathy with its clientele.

programme.title: Seat Alhambra
programme.desc: Although the Seat Alhambra doesn’t look particularly sporty, but when tested by two professional bikers, it shows that it is not to be underestimated.

programme.title: KIA Sorento
programme.desc: The Sorento is the flagship vehicle in the KIA model range. The Korean manufacturer hopes to conquer the premium SUV market by offering good quality at an attractive price. Does the Sorento meet the standards of a premium class vehicle?

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: The BMW X5M, Audi Q7, Mercedes GLS and Porsche Cayenne Turbo are among the strongest and fastest SUVs in the world. Sports utility vehicles made in Germany are the embodiment of technical perfection, superior performance and unique comfort.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: Luxury, lifestyle and exclusivity, no other cars transport these attributes better than the SUVs by Jaguar, Range Rover, Bentley, Volvo and Infinity. These stylish and excellently equipped SUVs embody a spirit of adventure and a zest for life.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: US SUVs and pickup trucks like the Cadillac Escalade, Chevrolet Tahoe, Ford Raptor or Dodge Ram are large, powerful and luxurious and exude the feeling of unlimited possibilities and adventure.

programme.title: Toyota MegaCruiser BXD10
programme.desc: The Toyota MegaCruiser BXD10 has its origins in the Japanese army. Its shape won’t win any beauty contests or achieve the best results in the wind tunnel, but this is not really the point with an SUV like this.

programme.title: Ford GT40
programme.desc: With their V8 cars, Ford showed that they were able to build race winners. The Ford GT40 was a prime example for that, especially in Le Mans.

programme.title: Aston Martin Rapide S
programme.desc: Aston Martin is breaking new ground with the sport sedan – the „Rapide S“. Ever since the official car of James Bond became the Aston Martin, this brand has achieved cult status. Desirable, timelessly elegant, 2-door sports coupes are the DNA. But even the venerable British brand does not escape evolution - because with the Rapide S, Aston Martin goes new ways.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: A trend is on the rise: going on mountain cruises in a sports car. As super cars become more comfortable and suitable for travelling in spite of their ever-increasing performance, what would be the perfect sports car for taking on the Alps: the Lamborghini Aventador Miura Homage, the Ferrari 458 Speciale, the McLaren 570S or the Porsche 911 Turbo S?

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: To drive or be driven: That is the question for people who can afford such a choice. When it comes to the Bentley Mulsanne with its extended wheelbase, one could be more delighted to sit in the back of the car than in the front. But what is the situation when it comes to the sporty Maserati Quattroporte? Or the upgraded BMW 7 series by Alpina with the model name B7? Or the original, the BMW 750i?

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Would you prefer a turbocharged or rather a naturally aspirated engine? With the 7th generation Chevrolet Corvette, buyers were able to choose between either. What's the more convincing model variation, the Grand Sport or Z06? Also: the McLaren 720, with its 4-litre BiTurbo V8. And: taking part in the "Bavaria Sportwagen Tour" with an AMG GTR.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: If you had the choice to select three cars for every occasion, which models would receive a spot in your garage? We took a look at the Rolls Royce Phantom, the Aston Martin DBS Superleggera and the Audi RS4 for this little mindgame.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: In 2018, the Audi R8 Quattro Performance received an upgrade. The new version shared some of its aerodynamic features with the Lamborghini Huracan. Also: the Porsche Macan S got a more powerful engine.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: The rebirth of French chic: the elegant DS 9 from Citroen's luxury brand. Plus: the Genesis GV80 offers luxury at a low price. And: a test drive in the exorbitantly expensive Mercedes-Benz 300 SL.

programme.title: Saab 93 and Saab 99 Turbo
programme.desc: In 1937 an airplane manufacturing company was founded in Sweden that later became the famous car manufacturer Saab. We present two of their iconic car models, the Saab 93 and 99 Turbo.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Being one step ahead of time has always been a bit pricier. But is the new BMW i8 just an luxurious, avant-garde carrier of technology or can it already be considered as a serious sports car? Why should you pay double the price compared to the BMW M4? Why shouldn’t you buy a good looking BMW M5, which has the same price, but is more functional? Supercars reveals the answers.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: The Porsche 911 GTS is the latest model in the iconic 911 sports car range. With an output of 430 HP it closes the gap between the S model and the GT3. Supercars gets the chance to take a ride in the new Porsche 911 GTS in California. Plus: The Roding Roadster is a small series lightweight sports car from Bavaria and uses technology from BMW under its bonnet.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: These days there's hardly a car manufacturer who doesn¿t build any kind of SUV. Three of the sportiest SUVs on the market are the Porsche Macan Turbo, Mercedes GLA 45 AMG and Audi RSQ3. Each of them comes with more than 300 HP; they are well prepared for any season and have ambitions to be sports car. Supercars finds out, if they have what it takes to be a sports car.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: The Porsche Panamera Turbo S is the most dynamic sedan in the world. No other car finds the perfect balance between calm gliding on the one hand and extreme performance on the other hand. 570 hp, 3,8 seconds from zero to 100 km/h and a top speed of 310 km/h are impressive performance data for this big car. Plus: the Jaguar XJR with a 550 hp V8 engine and the Mercedes CLS 500.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Luxury does not necesseraly mean to waste time. Hybrid is one of the techniques wich promises less fuel consumption with a still powerful engine. Lexus ist the pioneer in electrification of cars. Supercars drives the new LS 600h, The BMW Actiev Hybrid 7 and teh Porsche Panamera S E-Hybrid.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: The Silvretta Hochalpenstrasse in Austria is the ideal playground for the lightweight power packs Lotus Elise and Roding Roadster. These two roadsters are glued to the street and therefore a lot of fun to drive. And: the elegant but still very powerful Porsche 911 Targa 4S.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: If people hear the name Aston Martin they imagine James Bond adventures, British style, performance and luxury. The brand's Vantage N430 model is a sports car that makes drivers and enthusiasts feel the heritage of British race cars. Also: a combination of elegance and power, the Bentley Continental GTC Speed with its W12 Twin Turbo engine.

programme.title: Supercars

programme.desc: 第二次世界大戰後, 日本人山本幡男被囚禁在蘇聯的強制收容所, 儘管環境嚴酷如地獄, 為了能回到日本與妻子、子女重聚, 他仍奮力求存, 向其他戰俘訴說自己的信念: 「不可捨棄生存的希望, 回家的日子終會到來--」。八年後, 山本終於收到妻子寄來的明信片, 通過艱鉅的審查、遠渡而來的明信片只寫了一行字: 「我期待你歸來」。同時, 他竟不幸染病, 被醫生診斷只剩下三個月性命。在他的伙伴苦心進言下, 山本只能一邊抖著手, 一邊寫下遺書......改編自日本作家邊見純的暢銷小說, 以紀實的方式描寫戰爭的殘酷與人情的溫暖。飄越汪洋的一封家書, 記載的是一個感人肺腑的奇蹟。

programme.title: 破墓
programme.desc: 薩滿巫師花林和法師峯吉接受巨額委託, 遠赴美國為富豪家族的新生兒驅魔治病。花林立即感應到富豪祖先的陰影籠罩著整個家族, 禍根源於惡中之惡的不祥祖墳!二人決定聯手風水大師相德與禮儀師寧根, 打算以危險的血祭破墓儀式試圖為該家族改風水改命運。所有人都對此有絕對危險的感應, 但在花林的說服下, 最後仍挖開了墳墓, 卻意外釋放了埋藏在地下百年的秘密邪惡力量......

programme.title: 絕世好賓
programme.desc: 故事講億萬富翁方立國, 為個皇帝女Jennifer (梁詠琪) 請外籍保鏢兼司機。陳志傑 (劉青雲) 接受「特別任務」, 扮菲籍私人助理幫Jennifer, 搞出爆笑喜劇。

programme.title: 長津湖之水門橋
programme.desc: 1950年冬天, 冰天雪地的長津湖區域, 一場美國與中國煉獄般的血戰即將拉開序幕。中美雙方分別派遣最為精銳的王牌部隊出戰 - 中國人民志願軍第9兵團、美軍陸戰第1師, 步兵第7師。兩支部隊在戰役中多次展開驚心動魄的殊死較量, 中方在面臨極端嚴寒、食不果腹、以及巨大武器差距等諸多艱險條件時, 依舊毫無懼色、頑強抗戰、視死如歸, 最終成功炸毀水門橋, 並取得了抗美援朝戰爭中最為關鍵的一場決定性勝利。

programme.title: 最後的怒放
programme.desc: 離開日本40年的拳壇傳奇仁一, 忽然落葉歸根, 遇上失意的年輕拳手翔吾來拜師, 青春與年邁靈魂的碰撞, 相近的灰色軌跡令彼此不再猶䂊。幾經苦練和激戰, 翔吾只差一場就登上世一, 二人卻各自賭下餘生, 無視「為什麼死也要打下去」的拷問。

One Piece
programme.sub-title: Gathering into a Powerful Front! Luffy and a Group of Brutal Warriors!
programme.desc: With Luffy & the others recovering from Pica's attack, the game is afoot! Luffy has just enough time to regroup and set out to find Doflamingo, only to find that the dastardly Warlord has more enemies than he might realize! A strange argument breaks out.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Steady Progress! Luffy’s Army vs. Pica!
programme.desc: Don Chin Jao and Elizabello successfully break Pica's giant arm but the rock giant is unfazed and starts throwing even more destructive punches at Luffy and his band of unwanted collaborators! Meanwhile, Navy Admiral Fujitora moves into action.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: A Shocking Confession! Law's Soulful Vow!
programme.desc: Luffy and Moocy fast approach the showdown with Doflamingo - while the others with a beef against him continue to tag along. Meanwhile, Violet finds the key to Law's handcuffs, and Rebecca pledges to deliver it to him.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: A Big Collision! Chief of Staff - Sabo vs. Admiral Fujitora!
programme.desc: Luffy makes headway toward Doflamingo's refuge, making his way through Doflamingo's guards, while down below Admiral Fujitora faces off against Sabo, who has the power of the Fire Fist from eating the Flare-Flare Fruit!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: A Desperate Situation! Luffy Gets Caught in a Trap!
programme.desc: Luffy cuts a lucky break as Kelly Funk shows him a shortcut to the Palace! But all may not be as it seems... Meanwhile, Franky and Zoro are locked in one-on-one duels, while Robin, Rebecca, and Bartolomeo enlist the help of the Tontattas.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: A Great Escape! Luffy's Tide-turning Elephant Gun!
programme.desc: Penned in at the bottom of a well, Luffy and Law are caught in a trap! But someone has come to save them who they least expect! Meanwhile, the Tontattas help Franky break in to the SMILE factory, and Bartolomeo resorts to tactics he used in the Colosseum.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: A United Front! Luffy's Breakthrough to the Victory!
programme.desc: The Tontattas locate their captive comrades and seem to be able to get the message to them - the prison break is on! Meanwhile, heavy-hitters from the Colosseum turn from wringing each other's necks towards a unified plan.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The Second Samurai! Evening Shower Kanjuro Appears!
programme.desc: Hidden far underground, Kin'emon finds his old friend Kanjuro whose powers allow the two to, quickly, but not elegantly, escape to the surface! Meanwhile, Cavendish shares his fears that the "Birdcage" game Doflamingo is playing has been rigged all along.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: A Hard-Fought Battle Against Pica! Zoro's Deadly Attack!
programme.desc: The Tontattas are in full revolt! But can they keep their wits about them long enough to make it out? Meanwhile, Zoro finally gains the upper hand against Pica, and Franky finds a way to deal with Señor Pink.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The Little People's Princess! Captive Mansherry!
programme.desc: Franky finally makes it into the factory and the Tontattas are reunited with their captive friends! But Princess Mansherry is nowhere to be found. Factory manager Kuween becomes irate when ignored and launches an attack on Franky.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Invincible! A Gruesome Army of Headcracker Dolls!
programme.desc: Robin, Rebecca, and Bartolomeo draw closer to the Flower Field on the fourth level of the Royal Palace plateau, but a sudden attack by Gladius' exploding spheres sends Robin and Bartolomeo hurtling towards the level below.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Risking Their Lives! Luffy is the Trump Card for Victory!
programme.desc: Rebecca makes it to the Flower Field alone, but unfortunately finds company there that is less than friendly! Meanwhile, Bartolomeo pushes himself to the limit in order to help Luffy advance, but does he leave himself vulnerable in the process?

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: A Tearful Reunion! Rebecca and Kyros!
programme.desc: Diamante has Rebecca pinned and completely overpowered. If only the Soldier-san of her youth were able to protect her! Meanwhile, Luffy and Law finally surmount incredible odds to land themselves in striking distance of Doflamingo.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: One Shot One Kill! The Man Who Will Save Dressrosa!
programme.desc: Usopp uses Viola's Clairvoyance to prepare his ammunition to take Sugar out! But the slightest hesitation now will spell disaster, and the end of Luffy! Luckily for the Straw Hats, Usopp's ammunition has been specially designed for this situation!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Anger Erupts! Luffy and Law's Ultimate Stratagem!
programme.desc: The final showdown with Doflamingo begins, but the Warlord still has several tricks up his sleeve - including turning one of Luffy's own friends against him! Meanwhile Franky and Señor Pink are in a standoff to find out who is the coolest.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: A Noble Family! The True Identity of Doflamingo!
programme.desc: All hopes rest on Luffy and Law being able to take down Doflamingo; but the Warlord has other plans in mind as he gives the two the fight of their lives, and reveals his true, shocking history! Meanwhile, Sabo finds out Fujitora's true intention…

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The Ultimate Power! The Secret of the Op-Op Fruit!
programme.desc: With Fujitora's stalemate arousing suspicion in the Navy ranks, Law and Luffy stand seconds away from execution at the hand of Doflamingo! But before he dispatches them both, he shares the secret of his sway over the Celestial Dragons!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Sad Memories! Law, the Boy from the White Town!
programme.desc: The horrible secret of Flevance, the White Town, is revealed, giving clues to Law's traumatic past! A rage born from the lies of the World Government created a child who had the will to kill Corazon!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: A Celestial Dragon! Doffy's Stormy Past!
programme.desc: Law's attack on Corazon looks less successful than he thought! And after he's accepted into the Doflamingo Family, Corazon's mysterious silence hides a fact that may save Law's life - and a hidden danger Law must face in Doflamingo himself!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: A Rocky Road! Law and Corazon's Journey of Life!
programme.desc: Things grow stranger for Law as he learns the secret behind why Corazon feigns being mute! But the mysterious Corazon's actions are only beginning to baffle Law as he takes him on a journey to cure his White Lead Disease.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The Time is Ticking Down! Seize the Op-Op Fruit!
programme.desc: Corazon's double-dealing with the Navy raises suspicions both with Doflamingo and Law. But all that is secondary as Corazon finally has a chance to grab the Op-Op Fruit during a staged handoff arranged by the Government.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The Moment of Resolution! Corazon's Farewell Smile!
programme.desc: The Op-Op Fruit is in Corazon's hands! But the price he paid to get it might be too high... When Law goes for help, unfortunate coincidences intervene and leave the two vulnerable! Meanwhile, Doflamingo and his clan finally land at Minion Island.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Advance, Law! The Kindhearted Man's Final Fight!
programme.desc: Doflamingo & his Family begin to zero in on Corazon and Law's whereabouts, but Corazon has a plan to hide Law long enough to let him escape, even if that means sacrificing his own life. A chain of lucky coincidences allows the plan to be set into motion.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: To Be Free! Law's Injection Shot Blasts!
programme.desc: Violet runs down the status of the open battles raging in Dressrosa - the Straw Hats, the Tontattas, the executives of the Doflamingo Family - all of them clash around the island, but it's Law's revelation to Doflamingo that moves the action forward!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: An Intense Battle! Law vs. Doflamingo!
programme.desc: Luffy continues to battle Fake-mingo, but keeps accidentally battling Bellamy instead. Meanwhile the tide of battle turns against Law as painful scars from the past resurface. And Zoro gets unexpected help in his battle with Pica.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: A Decisive Battle Against the Executives! Proud Hajrudin!
programme.desc: Bellamy escapes Doflamingo's control, but it might be too late. His long history with Doflamingo unfolds and leads to an inglorious end. Meanwhile, Hajrudin has been beaten down, but a fire still burns in him to pay back the favor he owes!

programme.title: Praktische Ideen
programme.desc: Erleichter dir den Alltag! Die kleinen Helferlein, die du hier kennenlernst, sorgen für mehr Ordnung und Sauberkeit. Auch ökologische Aspekte, Sparsamkeit und innovative Techniken spielen eine Rolle. Das Angebot umfasst ein breites Spektrum von Reinigungsmitteln, Mikrofasertüchern, elektrischen Geräten und Wasserspar-Sets bis hin zu Kalkwandlern. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Das gemütliche Schlafzimmer
programme.desc: Das Schlafzimmer gilt als Oase der Entspannung. So richtig schön kuschelig wird es mit den Artikeln aus dieser Show: Bettwäsche, Plaids, dekorative Kissen, behagliche Steppbetten und bequeme Matratzen. Auf Basis von Mikrofaser kommen die Materialien u. a. als Flanell Fleece, Single Jersey, Satin und Interlock. Einfach gemütlich! (Senderinfo).

programme.desc: Cuando se pasa en compañía de tortugas, la vida en el carril lento es un viaje fascinante. JUST TURTLES analiza en profundidad a estos increíbles reptiles. Con una enorme gama de tamaños corporales, formas de caparazón y patrones, el mundo de las tortugas terrestres, galápagos y tortugas marinas es rico y variado, tal como se esperaría de animales tan antiguos. En la tierra o en el agua, la vida de estos resistentes animales es cautivadora.

programme.desc: El mundo que nos rodea contiene muchos sistemas complejos que funcionan perfectamente juntos. Durante muchos años ha habido un acalorado debate entre evolución y creación, con la pregunta central de todo: "¿Fue creada la Tierra o llegó a existir por sí sola?" Conozca a siete expertos en sus campos que han dedicado su vida al estudio de esta cuestión.

programme.desc: Después de la trágica muerte de su exnovia, Kyle Foster lucha por aceptar la responsabilidad de ser padre de la pequeña hija, Teigan, que tuvieron juntos. programme.title: La Confesión

programme.title: Presentimientos
programme.desc: La relación de Julia y Félix, una joven pareja de clase media, atraviesa un momento delicado. Se les ocurre la idea de irse unos días de vacaciones a la playa para salvar su relación. Cuando llegan a su destino, empiezan a discutir, y Julia coge el coche y se va. Tras oír el violento estruendo de un accidente, se detiene y sale para ver qué ha pasado. Al volver al coche, descubre que le han robado el bolso. Por si fuera poco, no encuentra el camino de la urbanización. Empieza así el angustioso deambular de Julia y Félix buscándose mutuamente en un paraje desconocido.

programme.title: Go Astro Boy Go!
programme.desc: Suzu está encantada con su nueva aplicación, que identifica y evalúa el peligro potencial de las especies animales. Pero el Equipo Astro es llamado a una misión en el África subsahariana, donde Dakarai y Akua están atrapados en un árbol con un león que se comporta de forma errática debajo. El Equipo Astro los rescata y, con el conocimiento felino de Astro Kitty, rastrean al león. Suzu y Astro se dan cuenta de que hay un grave problema con el suministro de agua de los leones: un río se ha secado. Cuando Suzu localiza un río alternativo, se siente satisfecha de sí misma, pero descubre, demasiado tarde, que está contaminado por los desechos de una antigua mina de oro. El Equipo Astro debe trabajar con Dakarai y Akua para darles un antídoto a los leones y asegurarse de que el río sea seguro para beber.

programme.desc: Der Wilde Westen ist gezähmt, der Zweite Weltkrieg gewonnen, Vietnam noch fern. In den 1940er-Jahren konzentriert sich Amerikas Bedarf an Helden auf Pioniere wie Chuck Yeager (dargestellt vom im Juli 2017 verstorbenen Sam Shepard). Der Testpilot durchbrach 1947 als Erster die Schallmauer. Zehn Jahre später schießen die Sowjets den Sputnik in den Orbit, das Wettrennen um die bemannte Raumfahrt begi

programme.title: Champion der Champions
programme.desc:
Noch fünf ehemalige Spitzensportler kämpfen um den Titel „Champion der Champions“. Tanja Frieden ist die letzte Frau im Feld und zeigt auch am vierten Tag, dass sie sich gegen die Konkurrenz behaupten kann.

Im Sofa-Gespräch wird es persönlich: Sie spricht über die enge Beziehung zu ihrer verstorbenen Mutter und darüber, wie sie gelernt hat, auf ihre innere Stimme zu hören.

programme.title: Die Schweiz von oben: Berner Oberland
programme.desc: Das Slow-TV-Format "Schweiz von oben" zeigt auf einzigartige Weise die Schönheit der Schweiz aus einer neuen Perspektive. Diese Episode zeigt eindrückliche Blicke aufs Berner Oberland. Die Zuschauenden fliegen unter anderem über Niesen und Brienzergrat nach Lauterbrunnen BE und Mürren BE. "Schweiz von oben" – eine einzigartige Reise durch die Schweiz. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Köstliches Kampanien
programme.desc: Über 100 Kilometer Küste und ein 180 Hektar grosser Nationalpark im Landesinneren, das ist die Region Cilento. Sie ist bekannt für eine vielfältige Küche, in der Büffelmozzarella, weisse Feigen, Hülsenfrüchte und Fisch einen festen Platz einnehmen. Ansässige zeigen ihre traditionellen Rezepte. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: SRF bi de Lüt – Hüttengeschichten

programme.title: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan
programme.desc: As Adm. James T. Kirk (William Shatner) and Capt. Spock (Leonard Nimoy) monitor trainees at Starfleet Academy, another vessel from the United Federation of Planets is about to try out the planet-creating Genesis Device in a seemingly deserted portion of space. In the process, two of Kirk's officers are captured by Khan (Ricardo Montalban), an enemy Kirk thought he'd never see again. Once more, Kirk takes the Enterprise's helm, where he meets Khan's ship in an intergalactic showdown.

rating.system: Saskatchewan Film and Video Classification Board

programme.title: Star Trek III: The Search for Spock
programme.desc: Adm. James T. Kirk (William Shatner) has defeated his archenemy but at great cost. His friend Spock has apparently been killed, the USS Enterprise is being scrapped, and starship physician Dr. Leonard "Bones" McCoy (DeForest Kelley) has taken ill. McCoy's odd behavior is evidence he's harboring Spock's katra, or animating spirit, and Kirk seeks to take the Enterprise back to the Genesis Planet and find his friend. Rebuffed, Kirk takes dramatic action that results in war with deadly Klingons.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home
programme.desc: Living in exile on the planet Vulcan, the ragtag former crew of the USS Enterprise steal a starship after receiving a planetary distress call from Earth: a space probe has entered into orbit around Earth, disabled global power on the planet and evaporated the oceans. Captain Kirk (William Shatner), Spock (Leonard Nimoy) and the rest of the officers travel back in time to retrieve now-extinct humpback whales, which Spock has deduced will communicate with the probe and send it away from Earth.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: A.I.: Artificial Intelligence
programme.desc: A robotic boy, the first programmed to love, David is adopted as a test case by a Cybertronics employee and his wife. Though he gradually becomes their child, a series of unexpected circumstances make this life impossible for David. Without final acceptance by humans or machines, David embarks on a journey to discover where he truly belongs, uncovering a world in which the line between robot and machine is both vast and profoundly thin.

programme.title: Rugrats Go Wild
programme.desc: Chuckie (Nancy Cartwright) and Tommy (Elizabeth Daily) find themselves stranded with their parents on a remote island. By coincidence, the adventurous Thornberrys are also exploring the island. So, with his talking dog, Spike (Bruce Willis), in tow, Tommy takes Chuckie on a walkabout meant to find Donnie Thornberry (Flea) and his sister, Eliza (Lacey Chabert). They'll need to be careful, though, as exotic leopard Siri (Chrissie Hynde) is hungry and not afraid to make her presence known.

programme.title: The Rugrats Movie
programme.desc: This animated comedy finds Tommy Pickles (E.G. Daily) trying to return his baby brother to the hospital after being warned by his mean-spirited friend, Angelica (Cheryl Chase), that once his new sibling is born his parents won't care about him. But, soon after they embark on the mission, Tommy and his friends lose their way in the woods and get into trouble with a pack of wild monkeys who have escaped from the circus. The kids begin to think that maybe things weren't so bad at home after all.

programme.title: The Spiderwick Chronicles

Zwischen Kegelclub, Nachbarschaftsstreit und Familienchaos mit Ehefrau Lisbeth (Irene Schwarz) sowie den Kindern Carmen (Janine Kunze) und Tommie (Axel Stein) sorgt sein übertriebener Pflichtgeist für urkomische Verwicklungen. 

Die Serie lief von 1999 bis 2010

programme.desc: 【守護我們的星球】是台灣第一部跨越南北極的生態電影，更是首度以台灣觀點、為地球生態發聲的紀錄片。拍攝團隊歷時 15 年，橫跨冰雪荒漠、潛入太平洋深海，遠征 115 個外景地，以克服嚴酷環境、生存繁衍的 82 個驚奇物種為敘事主角，真實呈現南北極宏偉壯麗、震懾人心的自然奇景；最後透過實際參與台灣科學家的極地研究，以台灣視角探討極地暖化與人類生存的未來，進而喚起世人守護地球環境的力量。

programme.title: Botanical Wonders:6
programme.desc: 邀請「亞洲廚神」王凱傑(Jason Wang)攜手加拿大籍植物生態學家崔佛(Trevor Padgett)組成探險雙人組，深入高山森林、百年白榕園，揭開臺灣植物的奇幻旅程。

programme.title: Not Far From Home:3
programme.desc: 這集《阿峇卡巴東南亞電台》的來賓，是紀錄片《家園不遠》的導演陳文良。《家園不遠》是一部探討在台印尼新住民的故事，他們是餐廳經營者、舞者、移工、捏麵人藝術家和一對印尼夫妻。而透過紀錄片呈現，觀眾會看到新移民是如何在台灣這片土地打造自己的家園。

Las experiencias de estas mujeres tratan de temas censurados por la sociedad y por lo tanto ellas los enfrentan en silencio, algunas de las situaciones que se examinan son: el abuso infantil, el embarazo no deseado, asesinatos, la pornografía y la violencia familiar entre otras. Al final de cada episodio se muestra una lista de centros o agencias de ayuda para personas que se sientan identificadas con los casos específicos, se hace un llamado para que busquen ayuda y rompan su silencio.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Juan conoce a su hijo y lo toma en sus brazos con ternura, Gabriela arma un escándalo hasta que Norma aclara que él tiene derechos porque es el padre, luego ella desacata la orden de su madre.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Fernando acepta la propuesta de trabajo de Gabriela, Norma accede, aunque exige que no se inmiscuya en su vida, ella está dispuesta a enfrentar a su madre por Juan. Rosario pregunta por Franco.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Juan le da un regalo a su hijo cuando vuelve a encontrarse con Norma en los límites de la hacienda, ella no esconde sus sentimientos. Ruth desafía a su madre y comienza a trabajar con Leandro.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Norma descubre que su bebé no tiene la cadena que le regaló Juan y se enfrenta con Gabriela, mientras que Martín le aconseja que vuelva con el padre de su hijo. Armando se enfurece con Rosario.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Fernando asume el cargo de administrador de la hacienda Elizondo, tanto Norma como Juan desconfían de sus intenciones. Óscar pide ser el galán del comercial de Jimena y Rosario busca a Franco.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Juan quiere que sus hermanos conozcan a su hijo, Norma no se opone y tiene una dura discusión con Gabriela. En la filmación del comercial, Jimena ve que el galán es Óscar, él la secuestra.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Norma decide bautizar al bebé y le dice a Juan que se llamará Juan David, después del bautizo él le presenta su hijo a todos los empleados. Gabriela interroga a Fernando sobre Dínora.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Martín le aconseja a Norma que se case con Juan, quien sueña vivir con ella y el niño como una familia. Rosario se le atraviesa con el carro a Franco y él la rechaza, Gabriela pacta con Dínora.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Rosario se propone reconquistar a Franco, lo que ella no sabe es que Armando piensa en acabar con él en la fiesta. A las hijas y al padre de Gabriela les extraña su nueva amistad con Dínora.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: En la fiesta, Franco cubre a Sara con piropos y la acompaña al carro, ella ve cuando lo secuestran. Jimena coquetea con un invitado para darle celos a Óscar mientras Norma confronta a su madre.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Sara arriesga su vida para salvar a Franco de los matones, él le agradece con un beso. Jimena llega a la casa tras burlarse de Óscar y se preocupa por su hermana, a ambas les espera un regaño.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Norma acude a su cita con Juan, pero se va al ver que no está solo, Óscar enfrenta a Jimena delante de Gabriela, quien se indigna al saber lo sucedido. Franco busca desquitarse de los matones.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Dínora le inventa a Norma que es novia de Juan, él no se queda tranquilo, busca a la madre de su hijo y trata de aclarar todo cuando otra mentira los separa. Franco pone a Armando en su sitio.

programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson, the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler in to a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Goes To School

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where he is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: New Neighbors Meet The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The V.I.P.'s
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion, after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets A Beatnik
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The Undercover Man
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: Mother Lurch Visits The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she an Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt Visits The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family And The Spaceman
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt And The Vocational Counselor
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight, members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

Hundreds of years later, Cuffy Williams (Robert Young), an American soldier stationed at the castle, discovers from young Lady Jessica (Margaret O'Brien) that he is a relative. Cuffy hopes to free Simon from his curse by displaying courage when under duress.

programme.title: The House on Telegraph Hill
programme.desc: Upon emerging from a Nazi death camp, Victoria Kowelska (Valentina Cortesa) takes the identity of a friend who died there. She travels to the United States where she meets her friend's son, Chris (Gordon Gebert), and discovers that she has come into a large inheritance. Eventually, she gets involved with the boy's guardian, Alan (Richard Basehart), and marries him. However, after some suspicious accidents, she starts to believe that Alan may be trying to kill her so he can claim the money.

programme.title: Raintree County
programme.desc: When Southern belle Susanna Drake (Elizabeth Taylor) visits Indiana, she falls for John Wickliff Shawnessy (Montgomery Clift), an abolitionist with strong ideals. However, John falters while he lets Drake tempt him away from his true love, Nell Gaither (Eva Marie Saint). After Drake deceives John into marriage, the two move to her New Orleans household, where he discovers that mental illness runs in her family. When the Civil War begins, John uses it to escape from the unhappy marriage.

programme.title: All Fall Down
programme.desc: Ralph Willart (Karl Malden) and his wife Annabell (Angela Lansbury) are constantly at odds over what to do with their son, Berry-Berry (Warren Beatty). While Annabell treats him like a saint, Ralph is more keen on his boy's womanizing ways. Berry-Berry's younger brother Clint (Brandon de Wilde) idolizes him despite what his father says, but when Berry-Berry develops a relationship with family friend Echo O'Brien (Eva Marie Saint), Clint discovers just how shallow his older brother is.

programme.title: 36 Hours
programme.desc: In occupied Germany in 1949, American military officer Jefferson Pike (James Garner) wakes up in a U.S. Army hospital with no memory of the previous five years. A kindly military psychiatrist (Rod Taylor) and his coolly detached nurse (Eva Marie Saint) draw out Pike's last clear memories, which are of General Eisenhower's final briefing for the Normandy invasion in June 1944. Soon, Pike realizes that his doctor and nurse are not who they claim to be, and that he is in great danger.

Then, on a dangerous mission with Gunner, Jim finally confronts something that just may scare him into never flying again.

When he meets daredevil pilot Alma Harding (Myrna Loy), he puts his charms on her, but she's more interested in going to the Amazon to search for her lost brother than entertaining his advances. In pursuit of her, as well as a hot story, Chris tags along. On the way, he competes with Bill Dennis (Walter Pidgeon), a rival reporter who is also eyeing Alma and the big scoop.

programme.title: Lucky Night

But she is cheered up by Bill Overton (Robert Taylor), a charming homeless man. The two share a wild, drunken night that ends in a way neither of them could have imagined.

programme.title: Cheaper by the Dozen

Fortunately, the couple frequently receives assistance from their eldest daughter, Ann, who often acts as a third parent to the many Gilbreth children.

programme.desc: Exploring why, from Liz Taylor to Attila the Hun, pain doesn't stop people from looking for love; how love is a driver of history, costing royalty their heads, generals their victories, and many people their sanity.

Разглеждане на Европа с нощен влак S1 E3 В този епизод разглеждаме защо хората и природата се нуждаят от тъмнината. Напускаме Будапеща в Магическия час. Докато слънцето изгрява над планините на Швейцария, научаваме за образуването на Алпите.

Дивата Виена Виена е един от най-биологично активните градове в света; дивата природа процъфтява в нейните дворци, църкви и градини, а Донауинзел служи както за контрол на наводненията, така и за зона за отдих.

Лосовете от Мацалу - дивите гиганти на Прибалтика Малцина знаят, че изключително голяма колония от лосове живее в Национален парк Мацалу край Балтийско море; проследяваме два едногодишни лоса през първата година на приемане сред възрастните лосове.

Скандинавия S1 E1 Зимата в Скандинавия се характеризира с полярната нощ, месеци, през които слънцето едва се вижда; този епизод показва как хората, животните и растенията се адаптират към тези екстремни условия.

Скандинавия S1 E2 Най-дългият ден в годината се чества в края на юни в цяла Скандинавия; в този епизод ставаме свидетели на това как животните и растенията се адаптират към предизвикателствата на полярния ден.

Еволюция S1 E1 Патрик изследва как животът е процъфтял на нашата планета - от предизвикващи гравитацията жирафи до устойчиви на радиация гъбички; може ли природата да ни научи как да изследваме извънземните светове?
Еволюция S1 E2 Патрик изследва най-важния двигател на еволюцията: оцеляването. Той среща животни, които са се адаптирали с времето, и открива как те пораждат вдъхновение за нови технологии.

Възходът на птиците S1 E1 Историята на птиците започва преди 220 милиона години. Наскоро е открита най-древната вкаменелост на съвременна птица, даваща нови данни как и защо само те са оцелели след астероида, ударил Земята.

Възходът на птиците S1 E2 Историята на птиците започва преди 220 милиона години. Наскоро е открита най-древната вкаменелост на съвременна птица, даваща нови данни как и защо само те са оцелели след астероида, ударил Земята.

Предупреждение за комари: новата тропическа заплаха за Европа Тропически болести като денга, малария, чикунгуня и вирусът на Западен Нил дълго време се смятаха за далечен проблем. Но сега те пристигнаха в Европа. Колко голяма е опасността на прага ни?

Чудните насекоми S1 E1 Разглеждаме разнообразието, красотата и вълнуващите стратегии на мравките в съответните им местообитания. Независимо дали са в Южна Америка или в Европа, светът на мравките е пълен с изненади.

programme.desc: Tori goes all out to master an iconic Hollywood Arts monologue in Sikowitz's class. Meanwhile, André and Robbie join a ballet class to meet girls, with disastrous results.

programme.desc: Tori has to defend herself after Jade claims Tori hurt her in a stage fighting exercise. Meanwhile, Trina has to fend off Robbie's advances when he thinks their stage kiss meant something.

programme.desc: Tori accidentally gets Beck fired from a small role in a movie, then must figure out a way to get him his job back. Meanwhile, Robbie suffers frightening nightmares about his best friend Rex.

programme.desc: Tori gets the lead in a high profile school musical, but freaks out when a stage makeup project goes awry, and she's left looking like a zombie on opening night.

programme.desc: After a jealous Jade dumps Beck, she soon regrets it and recruits Tori to help get him back. Meanwhile, Trina puts on a one-woman show and tells Robbie he better give it a good review… or else!

programme.title: Victorious: The Diddly-Bops
programme.desc: Sikowitz recruits the gang to form a children's band for a friend's party. When a leaked video of the group's performance becomes popular, Andre struggles to be taken seriously as a musician.

programme.title: Victorious: Cat's New Boyfriend
programme.desc: Cat begins dating Tori's ex-boyfriend, Danny (Matt Angel) and Tori becomes jealous. Meanwhile, Trina convinces Robbie, Andre, Jade and Beck to indulge their feet in callus-eating fish that she's been buying from some stranger.

programme.desc: Sikowitz invites the gang to have a sleepover at his house in order to teach them a lesson in method acting.

Infos zur Reihe:

In einer Woche treten jeweils fünf Wirte gegeneinander an. Die Konkurrenten bewerten dabei natürlich das Essen, aber auch den Service, die Atmosphäre, die Sauberkeit, das Gesamtkonzept und das nicht zu definierende „gewisse Etwas“! Mit dabei ist Spitzenkoch Mike Süsser, der die Teilnehmer der Woche besucht, den Wettstreit kommentiert und am Finaltag Punkte vergibt.

Beth Bellamy and Rick Witsken team up with power and precision as they face off against the dynamic duo of Eva Welsher and Altaf Merchant. programme.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL)
programme.sub-title: WPBL 2026 Grand Final - Chennai vs Delhi - Day 13 Tie 1
programme.desc: The grand finale of the World Pickleball League Season 2 descends upon Mumbai’s Jio World Garden for an unforgettable clash of titans between the Chennai Super Champs and Delhi Dilwale. Witness the technical mastery of Rika Fujiwara as she faces off against Alejandra Lopez in a high-stakes women’s singles match that sets the tone for the entire championship. The intensity reaches a fever pitch during a mixed doubles "masterclass" featuring Max Mansoor and Trang Huynh, which commentators hailed as the potential "rally of the season". With the "Band of Honor" and the ultimate league trophy on the line, every strategic "Pickle Play" and nerve-wracking volley contributes to an atmosphere so electric the crowd and commentators alike are left "going berserk".

programme.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL)
programme.sub-title: WPBL 2026 - Chennai vs Pune - Day 12 Tie 1
programme.desc: The stakes reach their absolute peak at Mumbai’s Jio World Garden for the first semifinal of the World Pickleball League Season 2, where there are "no do overs" for the Chennai Super Champs and Pune United. Witness a high-stakes tactical chess match as Chennai’s coach Jonny Goldberg makes the bold move to start premier player Rika Fujiwara against the "big and aggressive" Katie Morris in a critical women's singles clash. The intensity continues with a masterclass in mixed doubles featuring the powerful pairing of Lee Hwang Nam and Carlota Trevino facing off against Pune's consistent stars, William Sobeck and Magdalena Gregorio. Every point is a desperate grind for survival as these two titans battle through "world class" rallies for a guaranteed spot in the grand finale.

programme.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA)
programme.sub-title: NCPA 2026 Semifinal - Utah Tech vs. Florida Atlantic University
programme.desc: The atmosphere at the Arch Pickleball Center in Saint Louis reaches a fever pitch as the Utah Tech Trailblazers face off against the FAU Owls in a high-stakes semifinal showdown. This match showcases a "racing" intensity as Liam Duffin looks to maintain Utah Tech's momentum following their grueling victory over Colorado. Fans are treated to the technical "skills" and "freestyle" shot-making of Alex LaMacchia, whose crafty drop shots and highlight-reel volleys keep the score neck and neck throughout the opening game. With a spot in the National Championship on the line, both squads must navigate high-pressure video challenges and tactical timeouts in a match many spectators believe is worthy of the final itself.

But when Shen's plan is revealed, he must battle both on the streets and in the ring to obtain his final revenge. Face aux risques de pénuries et aux enjeux de souveraineté sanitaire, plusieurs pays européens cherchent à relocaliser la fabrication. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Petits curieux, grands écrans

programme.title: Population d'Afrique

(Senderinfo).

programme.title: Wari

D'ici 2080, près d'un quart des terres cultivables pourraient être exposées à la sécheresse. Face à cette urgence, des villages misent sur l'agroforesterie et une cuisine plus nutritive. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: CSI: Miami

programme.title: CSI: Miami
programme.desc: In einer Boutique kommt eine Frau ums Leben, im Kleid war eine Bombe explodiert. Ist Bombencrack Carlyle der Täter? Während das Team ermittelt, hat Lieutenant Caine (David Caruso) auch private Probleme: Sein Sohn gerät unter Mordverdacht.

programme.title: Leverage
programme.desc: Nate (Timothy Hutton) und sein Team fahnden nach der verschwundenen Frau eines Geschäftsmannes. Vieles spricht dafür, dass es sich um eine Heiratsschwindlerin handelt. Um hinter die Wahrheit zu kommen, schleusen sich die Jungs bei einer Wohltätigkeitsgala ein, auf der Junggesellen versteigert werden.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's the Bladebreakers versus Spintensity in the semi-finals of the American Tournament. But before the match can begin, Tyson is forced to withdraw with a stomachache he got from too much celebratory eating. Max, Ray and Kai must drag race their crafty foes through the whirlwind, highway-themed dish called the New Jersey Turnpike.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tensions rise as the American Tournament heats up. Max fights for a chance to beyblade against his mother's team the All-Starz in an upcoming match, while Tyson and the rest of the Bladebreakers realize that the All-Starz are a bigger threat then they previously thought. At the end of two tense rounds, Tyson and Steven are tied one-all'

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's the finals of the American Tournament and the Bladebreakers are going head to head with the All Starz with the winner going to the World Championships. In the first round, Tyson is pitted against Steve and at first things don't appear to be going Tyson's way. But with sheer determination, Tyson pulls out a victory that puts the Bladebreakers ahead one to nothing in the best of three finals.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The deciding match of the American Tournament Finals comes down to Max vs. Michael of the 'All Starz,' in a battle that pits science and technology against human spirit. Unfortunately for Max and the Bladebreakers, the trick dish turns out to be a replica of a baseball diamond'where Michael feels right at home!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: After narrowly defeating the All Starz at the American Tournament, Kenny decides he should record a database of the highs and low points of the BladeBreakers since the very beginning. In fact, through a series of flashbacks, the Chief along with Dizzi, takes a trip down memory lane as far back to the first time he ever met Tyson. With clips from various shows, Kenny narrates the progress of his friends who eventually form the BladeBreakers and go on to the Asian Tournament.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Traveling by boat across the Atlantic, the Bladebreakers must not only deal with Kenny's seasickness, but a gut-wrenching revelation. Tyson's on-board defeat at the hands of a mysterious foe - one wielding a Bit-Beast larger and stronger than any they've ever seen - exposes the team's vulnerability going into the Russian Tournament.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The kids are tricked into missing their boat, forcing them to spend the night in London where a mysterious videotape of Tyson's father is delivered to them. Later, Tyson's Beyblade is stolen and the kids are lured into a fight with the evil Cenotaph and his powerful Bit Beast, Sarcopholon. All seems lost until Kai defeats the mummy by using his own strengths against him. The team agrees to travel by land, learning from every European Beyblader they can find.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.sub-title: Darkness At The End Of The Tunnel
programme.desc: After their train is mysteriously hijacked, the kids find themselves in the dark recesses of a tunnel. This is where the Bladebreakers meet the members of the Dark Bladers! Soon the team is forced into a beyblade match to rescue Kenny from the monsters' evil clutches! But Kenny isn't the only prize in this dark match-up. For if the Bladebreakers lose, their bit-beasts are up for grabs'

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: As the BladeBreakers make their way to the World Championships in Russia, they are stuck in Paris where they end up wasting a day looking for Kai who had mysteriously disappeared. Tyson comes up with the idea of using the Eiffel Tower as a vantage point to speed up their search. Ray, Kenny, Tyson and Max make their way to the observation deck of the tower where they are confronted by the Dark Bladers, a foursome of zombie-like ghouls who have vowed to steal the Bladebreakers Bit Beasts as part of their ultimate plan to capture all Bit Beasts in the world. A massive battle ensues but the odds are against our heroes. Finally, Kai shows up with his newly modified Dranzer and almost single-handedly wins the battle. The Dark Bladers fade away after their humiliating loss and just when you'd think it's over, a mysterious kid named Oliver shows up'

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers spend an extra day in Paris and split up to see the sights. Ray catches up with his uncle, Max goes on a wild shopping spree and Kai goes in search of information. Tyson and Kenny try to see the Louvre but end up Beyblading Oliver, the French Champion. At first Oliver's Bit Beast, Unicolyon, is too much for Dragoon. But Tyson soon proves that even the French Champion has a thing or two to learn about Beyblading.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers arrive in Rome, searching for the mysterious Enrique. Scoffing at their Beyblade challenge, Enrique decides he'd rather spend the day with some of his lady-friends. But Tyson soon convinces him to 'Let it rip!' And after seeing Enrique's personalized BeyStadium, and his outrageous bit-beast, there's a good chance that Tyson may regret his actions'

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Unwilling to let his initial defeat to Enrique faze him, Tyson gets busy reworking his Beyblade. With Enrique having doubts about his own technique, and Oliver visiting him in Rome from France, the stage is set for a rematch. This time, Tyson pits the two heads of Enrique's Bit Beast Amphilyon against each other, and saves Enrique's life when Amphilyon turns on him.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Enrique and Oliver decide to take our heroes on a dirigible ride to visit Robert's castle. The reason - Tyson hopes to avenge an earlier loss to Robert that happened onboard the ship coming to Europe. Tyson's patience, however, is tested when they have to sit and wait for their host who is 'not to be disturbed.' So, Tyson decides to find Robert on his own and ends up getting lost in the medieval castles many eerie secret passages. Finally everyone converges in the room where Robert is playing chess against Johnny and it's here where Tyson throws down the gauntlet and challenges Robert to a rematch. Robert refuses and goes into a whole history lesson about how 'once you've defeated your enemy, the battle is over.' Meanwhile, the arrogant little Johnny decides to pick a battle with the most-worthy opponent in the room and chooses Kai. As the fight begins, it appears to be even, but then Johnny calls out his Bit Beast Salamulyon and totally destroys him. In the end, the Bladebreakers resolve that they have their work cut out for them to become the world champion Beybladers!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers have made themselves at home at Robert's mansion, refusing to leave unless the Europeans agree to a final Beybattle. To teach his guests a lesson, Robert agrees to a match at his new stadium. But there's one condition: If the Bladebreakers lose, they have to forfeit their berth at the world Championship. Ray and Oliver battle fiercely and the first round ends in a tie. Johnny and Kai, bitter rivals, step to the bowl. But can Kai defeat the man who defeated him?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Match two gets underway at the Olympia Coliseum, and with a little unsolicited help by his teammates, Kai walks away with a win. The match is tied and the Majestics grudgingly admit to themselves that the only way they'll win the contest is to fight as a team, as the Bladebreakers do. Facing off against Tyson in the final match, will Robert be able to apply the fundamentals of teamwork? And will the Bladebreakers ever discover who sent them on their cross-Europe trip in the first place'?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.sub-title: Hot Battle In A Cold Town
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers arrive in Moscow on a brisk winter's day in anticipation of the World Beyblading final tournament. As they search for their hotel in the chilly city, they happen upon Boris, a strange man who claims to be the head of a rather eerie Beyblading training center. With the charm of an old world count, Boris invites them to lunch and them brings them to the training facility where they meet the next generation of Beybladers. It's here where Boris decides that one of his pupils should test his blading skills against Tyson.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers run into some old friends in Russia when The All-Starz and the White Tiger Clan show up for an exhibition match. The Beybattle between the two teams ends in a tie and they become fast friends, except for Emily and Mariah, who refuse to speak to each other. Meanwhile, Kai returns to the Abbey to find out why it fills him with foreboding. He discovers a cruel Beyblade facility in the Sub-basements, housing twisted science experiments and an army of children being molded into deadly Beybladers. Kai's lost memories come flooding back as he realizes he was raised in the abbey. But has he discovered the truth too late?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Kai is torn between escaping the Abbey, and exploring it further in an attempt to unlock forgotten memories from his childhood. The Bladebreakers track down their missing teammate to the Abbey, but are denied access by two of its wunderkind bladers. When Kai discovers the existence of Black Dranzer, the world's most powerful Beyblade, Boris offers it to him - but only if Kai quits the Bladebreakers forever and rejoins the Biovolt Corporation. Flooded with memories of using Black Dranzer as a child, and the lure of its dark, corrupting power leads Kai to a shocking decision.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's the first day of the Beyblade World Championships in Moscow, and as our heroes leave their hotel, they still haven't been able to locate Kai who's been missing for some time. Regardless, they arrive at the tournament and meet up with both the White Tigers and the All Starz who invite them to watch their first match against the Demolition Boys. At first things seem fairly normal, that is, until they start to battle. Things go from bad to worse for the All Starz who are no match for the Demolition Boys who quickly go up 2-0 in the best of five events. In the next match, Michael has to square off against a mystery member of the Demolition Boys and it turns out to be none other than Kai who has defected from the Bladebreakers. In the final battle, Kai takes on all the All Starz at once' and wins!! After his victory, he commands the All Starz Bit Beasts to enter his blade and he announces to the world that he now possesses the most powerful Beyblade in the world!!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Determined to avenge the All-Starz' devastating defeat, the White Tigers face Kai in the Tournament. One by one, they fall before the power of Black Dranzer and watch, horrified, as their Bit Beasts are absorbed into Kai's Beyblade. The Bladebreakers storm the abbey in a desperate attempt to free their teammate. Tyson stumbles into Biovolt's secret lab and learns the truth about Kai's past from a gloating Boris. Tyson refuses to give up on his friend until Kai hands over his old Beyblade and tells him to leave. Will the Bladebreakers survive the loss of their most powerful member?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Downtrodden and dejected, the Bladebreakers ask themselves over and over again: 'Why would Kai betray us?' Soon enough, however, the boys get a chance to ask him themselves. Summoned by Kai to Beyblade on a frozen lake, the Bladebreakers must not only win to save their Bit Beasts, but must convince Kai that they will always be his teammates. Can they do it'?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Now that Kai is finally loyal to the 'Bladebreakers,' he returns the Black Dranzer to Boris, doing severe damage to the enemy headquarters in the process. Voltaire orders the operation to proceed, and Boris brings in the Demolition Boys to get the job done. It is revealed that BioVolt is creating a breed of powerful, savage, Bit-Beasts that are designed for War'and the plan is to use them to take over the entire World. The Demolition Boys attack the BBA bus, and Max bravely battles to save his friends. Unfortunately he loses his Bit-Beast, Draciel, in the process'

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers are stranded on the barren Russian Tundra after their run-in with the Demolition Boys when the Majestics mysteriously show up in their bus. After picking our heroes up, they stop at an abandoned palace where Robert challenges Tyson to battle. At first it seems strange that Robert would do this, but Tyson accepts and a battle ensues with Tyson losing two straight. He becomes infuriated! Robert then tells Tyson that he must harness his power back into his blade, which totally confuses Tyson.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The World Championship Finals are finally here and Kai insists on Beybattling first, hoping his knowledge of the Demolition Boys will give him an advantage over Spencer. But in the first set, Seaborg, Spencer's whale Bit Beast, uses the water in the Black Sea Bowl to create a tsunami, which overwhelms Dranzer. Kai is desperate for victory and Voltaire makes him a tempting offer: the power of Black Dranzer in exchange for betraying his friends and stealing their Bit Beasts. Kai stays true to his heart and resists his grandfather.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: After Kai's first round loss to the Demolition Boys in the World Beyblade Finals, it's Ray's turn to take on Bryan in a best-of-three match. Ray learns the hard way that Bryan is a nasty competitor who'll do anything to win - including putting Ray himself through the ringer. When it's discovered that Bryan's attack includes the ability to manipulate air itself into a weapon, Ray faces a troubling realization. To negate Bryan's fury, he must put his own well being at risk. But Ray's Bit-Beast Driger has other ideas, and it offers up selfless act of its own.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: After a devastating match puts Ray in the hospital, Tyson trains his heart out to prepare for his battle against Tala, leader of the Demolition Boys. What Tyson doesn't know is that Tala has become one of Boris' weird experiments, uploaded with dangerous Biovolt technology. Meanwhile, Max's parents work together to come up with an improved Beyblade that can combat the existing threat of the Demolition Boys' prowess. Can it even come close to competing against'Cyber-Tala?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It is the finals of the World Beyblading Championships in Moscow with Tala from the Demolition Boys and Tyson tied at one game a piece in the best of three finals. With the victory, the tide has turned in favor of Tala who warps the two warriors into a giant iceberg where there is no contact with the outside world. The second battle begins, and it takes little time for Tala to combine his multiple Bit Beasts into one and take the lead in the best of three finals. Meanwhile, the evil Voltaire, head of the Biovolt Corporation looks on and begins celebrating the victory, which translates into his domination of the corporate world.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson is back home from just winning the World Beyblade Championships and he thinks he's one hot dude!! But after disrupting his homeroom at school, he's punished with a detention which makes him late for a local tournament. When he finally get there, he's confronted with a mystery kid, Mister X, who battles his way to the finals to face off against Tyson.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Kenny learns that the cloaked Blader named Ozuma, who defeated Tyson in an informal, Supermarket-sponsored Beybattle, was using an invisible Bit-Beast. Tyson demands a rematch against the strange opponent ' and loses for a second time when Dragoon mysteriously fails to appear on command. Effects from the battle damaged Dizzi, whom Kenny endeavors to repair. Meanwhile, a group of shady Men in Black have been busy monitoring Tyson and Ozuma the entire time. At school, tensions between Tyson and Hilary continue to rise.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson still can't get over losing his town's Beyblade Tournament to the mysterious Mister X. Kenny and Dizzi try to come up with some answers but discover a greater mystery. On the same day as Tyson's loss, Max and Ray were also visited by similar shadowy figures that defeated them as well. While Tyson does his best to avoid his school chores, Kenny makes a startling discovery about Mister X's Beyblade. Unfortunately Tyson, unaware of this new information, unexpectedly runs into Mister X at the park and challenges him to a rematch!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson heads to the park to meet Kenny, who has a plan to get Dragoon back 'on line'. But when Kenny and Hilary are kidnapped, Tyson is forced to jump through a series of hoops set out by their captors, which test his speed and determination. After successfully completing their orders, Tyson finds himself on a ship equipped with a fancy computer system ' and his friends, locked in a glass-walled cage. But what do the kidnappers want ' and how far will they go to get it?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson and Kenny are safe on dry land once again but are totally baffled trying to figure out why Kenny and Hilary were kidnapped by two mystery men. The best that they can deduce is that two factions are out to steal the Bit Beasts of all the members of the BladeBreakers. This leads them to wonder about Kai who supposedly has retired.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Inside Gideon's training center two of his henchmen discover a talented Blader named Snakey and offer to equip his Blade with the Magtram. The Magtram is a device that creates a magnetic field around the user's Beyblade and gives an unfair advantage to anyone using it. Kenny and Hilary are on the look out for their mysterious captors when Tyson shows up with a new scheme to find Ozuma. Out of nowhere, Snakey shows up and challenges Tyson to a match.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson and Kenny try to determine what the mystery material was inside Snakey's Beyblade that made it so magnetic. Kai is tight-lipped after rejoining his friends following his draw against Dunga. Kai crashes at Tyson's place, but departs quickly after old grievances resurface, and Hilary suspects him of being a spy. Tyson and Kenny e-mail Max's Mom, asking for help with their analysis of the mystery metal, while Hilary suggests visiting another person who could help them - Mr. Dickenson.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: At long last, Max and Ray rejoin their friends and the Bladebreakers are back together again! Just in time to meet their opponents, Team Psykick. With one week to train, the guys have victory on their brains ' especially after Max and Kenny reveal the new technology developed by Max's mom. The MG Core produces a magnetic field similar to the one in the Magtram technology, giving the user optimal control over their Beyblade and increasing the Beyblades power ten fold. However, it's not an easy thing to control, and the guys have a rough start.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers were on route to take on Team Psykick in a tournament when the Driver filled the bus with sleeping gas.
